lines.text: Micah tells the leaders of Jacob they should know justice, yet they hate good and love evil.
The leaders will cry out to Baal, but he will not answer them, and the LORD will hide His face.
Night will come over the prophets who lead God's people astray, and the seers will cover their mouths.
Micah is filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, and the leaders build Zion with bloodshed.
Her kings teach for a price, and because of the leaders Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble.
